title: Profit in millions
statementMd:
For movies with both budget and gross known, show title and profit (gross minus budget) rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `title`, `profit`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, ROUND(gross_millions - budget_millions, 1) AS profit FROM movies WHERE budget_millions IS NOT NULL AND gross_millions IS NOT NULL;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
